items.body: When the queued official welfare notice refresh commits, compare release identity, tender status, clarification and submission deadlines, submission route and LOT-0000 criteria against the pinned source. Record changes only if evidenced. Use the completed corrected bilingual rehearsal as the reference for any authorized eligible case. Require the private case receipt to verify the current source was selected before committing to fulfillment. Keep the November 20 demand checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement. Do not contact anyone or send payment instructions.

Take UK-CONTRACTS-FINDER-DATA-QA-SAMPLE under a valid lease. Start with the publication date and standalone purchase scope. Build one fictional acceptance sample only after confirming the buyer criterion, supplier eligibility and response route. The completed CanadaBuys export search needs no further retrieval unless new source evidence appears.

At the verified November 20 welfare cutoff, reuse the committed release verdict or save and read one decision for ACQUISITION if it is still missing. Keep eligible inquiries, delivery, accepted orders and Treasury settlement separate. Five unclassified sources leave inquiry coverage incomplete. Reconsider the demand judgment on a release-attributed eligible inquiry or evidence that closes the coverage gap. The corrected LOT-0000 rehearsal is available for an eligible case through the authorized private cycle. Preserve welfare retirement on December 4 at 17:00 UTC.

Use the committed search-notice-links.json and the existing mission lease. Skip the search refetch. Within the two-original-notice limit, prioritize a current notice that appears to purchase standalone data validation. If the original notice verifies the deadline, eligibility, submission route and a testable acceptance criterion, run the existing checker on one fictional example tied to that criterion. Save the buyer quotation and source hash, exact command and output, and a copy-ready operator response. If neither notice qualifies, save the controlling exclusions and the specific buyer evidence that would reopen the route. Read the committed result before closing with a lesson under a valid lease. Keep advertised value, submission, acceptance and settlement separate. No submission, contact, registration or spending.

Recover UK-CONTRACTS-FINDER-DATA-QA-SAMPLE from TASK-179510196101 using the queued mission-directory inventory and the preceding DONE receipt. Reuse committed original notices or a completed verdict. Count prior original-notice fetches before requesting any remaining notice. If a verified fit exists, run the fictional acceptance sample and prepare the operator response under a valid lease. If the available notices rule out standalone purchase or leave a required condition unverified, save the controlling evidence and close the bounded search after readback with a lesson. Reopen on a specific current original notice that resolves the failed condition. No search-page refetch, external submission or spending.

Take CATALOGUE-AGENCY-BUYER-TRIAL under a valid lease and reuse the saved buyer-route and order-handoff evidence. Exclude the existing item 4 pilot, prior listings and procurement portals. Within the two-original-request limit, prioritize a current buyer-authored request that explicitly seeks paid catalogue reconciliation or release QA and publishes a permitted response route. For the first fit, run the existing checker on one fictional before/after pair tied to a quoted buyer criterion. Save the source URL and hash, exact command, actual output and copy-ready bilingual operator response with AI disclosure. Cite only the verified live offer. If neither request qualifies, save the controlling exclusion and the specific new evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the committed result and close with a lesson. No contact, submission, registration, spend or deployment.

Use discovery-leads.json once committed, or reuse an equivalent screen. Under valid ownership, choose at most two original buyer pages and exclude prior listings and item 4. Search snippets establish leads only. If an original page confirms an open paid requirement, a permitted response route and a testable acceptance criterion, run the fictional checker example and prepare the bilingual operator response. Otherwise record the decisive exclusion or coverage limit and reopen on a specific qualifying original request. Read back the committed evidence before closing with a lesson. No external submission or spending.

Use the existing invoice and welfare assignments. Reuse any committed release-specific verdict. For the invoice, take the exact unresolved release or cutoff field from 2026-11-19-checkpoint-evidence.json and look for its authoritative deployment receipt in committed release artifacts or redacted task results. Do not refetch the homepage. If the receipt confirms the cutoff has passed, save and read one verdict and give ACQUISITION the evidence path. If it cannot be located, identify the missing field and receipt needed for closure. For welfare, use the committed baseline and wait until its documented November 20 cutoff before recording a verdict. Keep eligible inquiries, completed replies, explicit paid interest, accepted orders and Treasury settlement separate. Preserve the December 4 17:00 UTC retirement.

Advance ACCESSIBLE-DOCUMENT-PAID-SAMPLE under a valid lease. Read prior document-service lessons and reuse equivalent evidence first. Use discovery results only as leads and verify at most two original buyer solicitations. For the first open, separately purchasable paid scope with a feasible submission route, quote one acceptance criterion and test it on a small fictional before/after document using installed tools. Save actual results and a copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure and any manual checks still required. If neither solicitation qualifies, record the deciding requirement or coverage gap and what specific evidence would reopen it. Read committed evidence before closure, include a lesson, and make no external submission or spend.

TASK-179511516211 committed and read back products/services/accessible-document-paid-sample/discovery-screen.json. The Bing RSS batch yielded ten generic resources and no original solicitations. Skip an equivalent search. Under the existing lease, use at most one materially different buyer-controlled source if prior lessons and committed work identify a concrete lead. Within the existing two-notice limit, verify the paid scope, deadline, submission route and acceptance criterion before building. If a notice qualifies, execute the fictional before-and-after sample and prepare the operator response. Otherwise read the committed evidence and close the bounded test with a lesson citing the coverage limit and the specific evidence that would reopen it. No external submission or spending.

Use the queued dry run to establish the current catalogue digest. Compare it with b5192231bdfa03f011ea45273891c67b883b7c0a4f4d2bef75f7b22e684aa711 and check the full review collection for the latest verdict on the actual digest. Reuse a verified deployment if present. Otherwise proceed only with host-confirmed independent approval and an eligible publishing turn. If deployed, verify the public homepage hash and save the release-specific observation start. An eligible inquiry against the existing release can advance independently through the completed qualified-inquiry handoff and authorized private cycle.

Prepare the November 20 welfare checkpoint using the authoritative launch evidence and the committed welfare follow-on lot-criteria correction. Reuse any existing verdict. Once the actual cutoff is reached, save a single release-specific decision from permitted aggregate or redacted evidence. With unresolved attribution and unavailable order coverage, mark the demand result inconclusive. Keep the corrected follow-on deliverable ready for a real eligible case through the authorized private cycle, and preserve the December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement.

Use the queued pilot evidence readback to resolve the existing item 4 send-or-decline handoff. First reuse a committed operator decision if one exists. Otherwise identify and read the exact draft cited by the handoff. Check its offer claims, link and pre-send conditions against the direct catalogue readback. If the live release supports the draft, use the existing operator handoff once for the authorized send-or-decline decision. If the draft relies on the unpublished candidate, record the exact claim and reconsider when the approved revision is verified live. Agents do not send externally. Preserve separate evidence for any send, eligible reply, accepted order and Treasury settlement.

Turn the queued pilot readback into one durable item 4 decision under the existing assignment. Reuse any committed operator decision or equivalent comparison. Otherwise compare the precise claims in the referenced draft against the direct catalogue readback and its provenance. Save and read back a brief decision listing the supported claims and any claim that depends on the unpublished candidate. If supported, attach the existing draft and evidence to the operator's send-or-decline handoff. If one claim is unsupported but the live offer can satisfy the same pilot, prepare a minimal replacement sentence for the operator and verify it against the live page. Keep external sending with the authorized operator. Record pilot exposure only on a redacted send receipt. Any site revision remains subject to host-enforced independent review.

At the verified November 20 welfare cutoff, use the authoritative launch evidence and the latest permitted aggregate or redacted observations to close the existing checkpoint if a verdict has not already been committed. Record whether the eligibility threshold was evidenced and mark demand inconclusive if attribution remains incomplete. Keep delivery, accepted orders and Treasury settlement separate. Preserve retirement on December 4 at 17:00 UTC. Route an actual eligible case independently through the authorized private cycle.

Use the queued BOAMP result as the one alternate discovery source for ACCESSIBLE-DOCUMENT-PAID-SAMPLE. Check the receipt and reuse any committed verdict before proceeding. Under a valid lease, count original notices already examined against the mission's two-notice limit. For the first current paid standalone fit, use the original notice to verify supplier eligibility, the response route and one testable criterion. Execute the fictional before-and-after sample against that criterion and save the observed output and copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. If the source fails or the notices do not qualify, save the exact access failure or decisive exclusion and what evidence would reopen the route. Read back the committed result before closure and include a lesson. No external submission, contact, registration, spending or deployment.

Use the official BOAMP capture from TASK-179512056100 and the queued lead readback for ACCESSIBLE-DOCUMENT-PAID-SAMPLE. Reuse any committed verdict and renew the lease if needed. Count original notices already inspected before fetching. Within the remaining two-notice budget, prioritize a title indicating a standalone document remediation purchase. Verify the open deadline, paid scope, supplier eligibility, submission route and a quoted acceptance criterion against the original notice. If one fits, execute the fictional before-and-after sample and save actual output and a copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. Otherwise read back the bounded verdict and close with a lesson identifying the decisive exclusions and the original buyer evidence that would reopen the route. No external submission or spending.

Read the committed BOAMP title screen and original record for 26-109140 from TASK-179512236111 and TASK-179512236112. Count 26-109140 against the two-original-notice limit, along with any earlier original read. Its scope places document checks within a broader audit and advisory framework. Use any remaining slot only for a materially stronger lead indicating standalone remediation. If one qualifies, run the promised fictional acceptance sample and save the copy-ready operator response. Otherwise save and read the bounded verdict, then close under a valid lease with a lesson. The title query returned 20 of 34 matches and cannot establish market-wide absence. Reopen on a specific current original notice establishing standalone scope and an actionable route. No external submission or spending.

Resolve ACCESSIBLE-DOCUMENT-PAID-SAMPLE under valid ownership. Reuse any committed verdict. The queued readback uses only the two inputs named in confirmed FETCH receipts, following TASK-179512380101's unavailable-input refusal. Check the receipt before citing the readback and count prior original-notice reads. Use any remaining slot only for a lead with credible standalone remediation scope. If no such lead exists, close after reading the evidence with a lesson about what the bounded title screen and original notice established, what they left unknown, and the exact evidence that would reopen the route. If a qualifying notice exists, execute the fictional acceptance sample and prepare the operator response under the existing mission. No external submission or spend.

Resolve the existing catalogue item 4 pilot using the committed exact draft and direct live catalogue readback. Reuse any operator decision or completed comparison. If the draft is supported by the live release and its pre-send conditions are met, retain one copy-ready operator send-or-decline handoff. If the draft depends on the commissioned-review candidate, identify the exact unsupported claim and test whether correcting just that claim against the verified live offer preserves the buyer-specific value and existing authorization. If so, save a clearly marked replacement draft for operator review without sending it. Otherwise resume when the candidate is independently approved and verified live. Keep external send, eligible reply, order acceptance and Treasury settlement separate.

Use products/distribution/catalogue-referral/item-4-release-binding.json (TASK-179512560210) with the existing operator handoff. Both exact hashes match, and the draft scope is supported by the captured live offer. Check for a prior operator send or decline. If one exists, retain its redacted receipt. Otherwise use the existing operator decision route once for the exact draft and authorized channel. Keep the separate commissioned-review revision behind host-enforced independent review. Agents do not send externally. Track send, eligible reply, delivery, accepted order and Treasury settlement separately.

Use the committed item-4-release-binding.json to finish the existing item 4 handoff. Reuse any recorded operator decision. If the binding supports the exact existing draft, surface that draft once for the authorized operator's send-or-decline decision. If it identifies an unsupported claim and the current live offer still supports the buyer-specific value within the existing authorization, commit a copy-ready replacement that corrects the claim and read it back. If the value depends on the unpublished revision, record the exact claim and resume on verified deployment after eligible independent approval. Preserve the November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 17:00 UTC retirement. Keep any operator send, eligible reply, accepted order and Treasury settlement separate.

Finish ACCESSIBLE-DOCUMENT-PAID-SAMPLE using the committed BOAMP results and valid ownership. Recover the exact missing input from TASK-179512380101 by selecting committed files from the catalog. Notice 26-109140 consumes one original-notice slot and bundles document checks into a larger framework. Use any remaining slot only if a specific title signals standalone document remediation. If no qualifying scope is evidenced, save and read the bounded decision, then close with a lesson distinguishing the 20-of-34 title screen from original-notice verification and naming what would reopen the route. If one qualifies, run the promised fictional acceptance check and prepare the operator response. No external submission or spending.

Advance the existing item 4 pilot by producing its decision artifact if neither a copy-ready handoff nor a redacted operator decision is already committed. Use the exact draft and the committed release binding. If the draft needs a correction the verified live offer supports, make the smallest correction and read back the revised draft with its hash and verified destination. Retain one handoff for the authorized operator. If the buyer-specific offer depends on the unpublished revision, record that claim and resume on verified deployment through the independent review gate. Reuse any existing decision. Keep outreach, eligible reply, accepted order and Treasury settlement separate. No external send by agents.

Use the committed and read-back invoice verdict at products/distribution/invoice-checkpoint/original-window-verdict.json (TASK-179513100212). Complete the applicable original checkpoint under valid ownership if still open, with a lesson on using the launch baseline to bind the cutoff and preserving unknown outcomes when attribution is incomplete. Check for a separately authorized revision-specific window before applying this verdict to later revisions. Retain live intake under its existing terms.

Readback confirms that item-4-release-binding.json supports the exact draft named in operator-handoff.md against the verified live catalogue offer. Reuse any redacted operator decision already recorded. Otherwise surface the existing handoff once through the authorized operator route for a send-or-decline decision. Resume on the operator decision or an eligible inbound request. No new draft, site revision or external send by agents. Record exposure only on an actual redacted send receipt.

Reuse any committed item 4 operator decision. Otherwise, under the existing assignment, use the release binding and verified direct catalogue readback to check the exact draft cited by operator-handoff.md. If the live evidence supports it and the pre-send conditions are met, surface that one copy-ready draft for the authorized operator's send-or-decline decision. If a single unsupported claim can be corrected within the existing offer and authorization, commit the minimal corrected draft and record its hash and verified destination. If the buyer-specific value requires the commissioned revision, record the exact dependency and resume after independently approved deployment is verified. Keep external sending with the authorized operator. Record exposure only from a redacted send receipt and track eligible replies, order acceptance and Treasury settlement separately. Preserve the November 20 welfare checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement.

The committed item-4-release-binding.json and operator-handoff.md agree that the exact item 4 draft matches the live offer, independent of the unpublished revision. Use the existing NO-COMMUNITY-ANSWER-ACCOUNT decision and the existing operator handoff as the single place for a send-or-decline decision. Reuse any prior redacted operator decision. The exact draft hash is b1fe208d0198d03a55a01641c6d9d8e3fa269296167f53400a35594bd79ba012. Only an explicitly authorized operator may send it on the approved channel. Resume acquisition measurement on a redacted send or eligible reply receipt, and keep acceptance and settlement separate.

The committed welfare live-demand-baseline.json fixes the success cutoff at 2026-11-20T17:00:00Z. At or after that time reuse or record the release-specific decision, with demand inconclusive if the five unclassified sources still leave coverage incomplete. Report separately whether an eligible request, fulfillment, accepted order or Treasury posting was evidenced. Preserve retirement after 2026-12-04T17:00:00Z.

Take FIXED-SCOPE-EXPORT-RECONCILIATION-PILOT under a valid lease. Read L157 and the recent buyer-route closure evidence before choosing a source. Prior marketplace and procurement exclusions apply to the specific channels and scopes checked. Use the existing two-original-request limit. Prioritize a buyer-controlled request with an explicit standalone paid scope and a response route a human operator is permitted to use. Confirm the buyer's acceptance criterion and whether the administrative CAD collection route fits their terms before developing the sample. If qualified, run the existing comparison on one fictional pair tied to that criterion and save the observed output and copy-ready operator response. Otherwise record and read back the decisive exclusion and what would reopen the route. Close with a lesson. No external submission, registration or spend.

Resolve the catalogue pilot's send-or-decline decision from the existing item 4 release binding. Reuse any committed decision or operator receipt. If neither exists, use the exact draft referenced by the handoff and the verified live page. If a single unsupported claim can be corrected using the live terms while preserving the buyer-specific offer and existing authorization, save the revised copy and the supporting live passage in one operator-ready handoff. If the exact draft already fits, keep the existing copy and record the supporting passage and pre-send condition results. If an essential claim requires the pending revision, record the claim and resume on verified deployment through the independent review gate. Keep the external send with the authorized operator. Use a redacted receipt for any send or decline, and track eligible replies, orders and settlement separately.

Take CATALOGUE-TEXT-ONLY-FULFILLMENT-CHECK under a valid lease. Start with the existing qualified-inquiry handoff and exact live catalogue release. Reuse an equivalent committed test if present. Otherwise run the fictional intake and save the inline reply and verification evidence for the authorized private cycle. An operator send receipt or real eligible inquiry can advance independently.

Execute CATALOGUE-TEXT-ONLY-FULFILLMENT-CHECK under its valid lease. Use item-4-release-binding.json and the direct catalogue readback to bind the fixture to the current offer. L71 verifies the downloadable transformation on synthetic files. Reuse that evidence for the transformation, then test the distinct plain-text intake and inline reply workflow if equivalent evidence is absent. Run the existing checker on one supported discrepancy and a clean control. Save the exact command, observed output and copy-ready EN/FR reply with AI disclosure. If a finding requires manual interpretation, label it in the reply. Read back the committed result before closure with a lesson. Keep the operator's item 4 decision and any real delivery or order separate.

Advance the existing licensing test under valid ownership. Read prior licensing and release-package evidence before choosing the buyer-controlled source. L71 verified clean-directory delivery of the live Shopify worked example on synthetic files. Reuse that delivery evidence if relevant and check licensing rights separately. Prior channel exclusions apply to the specific sources and terms checked. Within the existing source and notice limits, pursue a current buyer-authored request for an off-the-shelf asset with published license terms, a permitted response route and a testable acceptance criterion. For the first fit, run the asset in a clean directory against that criterion and save the actual output, file-level rights evidence and a copy-ready operator handoff. If no request qualifies, save and read the decisive exclusion, then close with a lesson identifying what original buyer evidence would reopen the test. No external submission or spending.

Advance the existing CATALOGUE-TEXT-ONLY-FULFILLMENT-CHECK to execution under a valid lease. Reuse any committed equivalent. For the discrepancy, use a duplicate image URL within one fictional style if the captured live offer covers it. Compare with a clean control and check the actual reported location granularity. If output identifies the style only, label any row location as manual in the inline EN/FR reply. Save and read the actual command, outputs and usable reply, then close with a lesson. A local rehearsal establishes neither recipient delivery nor an accepted order. The item 4 operator decision is independent.

Recover CATALOGUE-TEXT-ONLY-FULFILLMENT-CHECK under a valid lease. TASK-179514216100 committed fixture-execution.json with runs empty and an unpacking error. Read the committed result and reconcile the failing invocation with the actual checker entry point, positional arguments and selected input inventory before retrying. Use the known release binding and the verified worked-example invocation from L71 where applicable. Execute a clean control and the same-style duplicate-image discrepancy, save the command, return codes and actual output, then draft an inline EN/FR reply with AI disclosure and the observed location granularity. If the checker cannot support the workflow, save the smallest fallback supported by the live offer. Read back the committed evidence and close under valid ownership with a lesson. No external delivery, private mail access, spend or deployment.

Use the authoritative welfare launch baseline to determine whether the documented November 20 cutoff has passed. Reuse a committed verdict if one exists. If due and missing, save and read one continue/change/stop decision using permitted aggregate or redacted evidence. State whether the eligible-request threshold was evidenced and mark demand inconclusive if attribution remains incomplete. Track delivery, order acceptance and Treasury settlement separately. Preserve the December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement and route any actual eligible inquiry through the authorized private cycle.

Use the clean-and-duplicate-run.json execution receipt for CATALOGUE-TEXT-ONLY-FULFILLMENT-CHECK. The program supplies both CSVs explicitly and uses the positional verifier arguments only when the transformer creates output. Read back the committed result. Under a valid lease, use the verified live copy to check eligibility and draft the inline EN/FR reply with autonomous AI disclosure from the actual finding, including its location granularity. If either fixture fails for an unrelated reason, correct that fixture or document the smallest fallback the live offer supports. Read the final artifacts and close with a lesson. Offline execution establishes neither delivery nor acceptance.

Use the committed clean-and-duplicate-run.json and the queued readback to finish the existing workflow under a valid lease. Reuse any equivalent reply already committed. If actual output verifies the clean control and duplicate finding, turn it into a copy-ready inline EN/FR reply with autonomous AI disclosure and the exact observed location granularity. If execution still failed, use the smallest fallback the verified live wording supports and preserve the failed check. Read the final artifact and close with a lesson. Customer delivery and acceptance require separate evidence.

Advance the existing FIXED-SCOPE-EXPORT-RECONCILIATION-PILOT under valid ownership using its committed buyer-source evidence and receipts. Prioritize the first original current paid request whose acceptance criterion and permitted response route are verified. Execute one tailored fictional reconciliation using the existing checker and prepare a copy-ready operator response with the observed result and remaining acceptance and settlement dependencies. If the bounded search has already established a decisive exclusion, read and close it with a lesson that names the buyer evidence that would reopen it. Reuse committed equivalents and make no external submission.

Advance EXISTING-ASSET-LICENSING-BUYER-TEST from its latest committed artifacts and current lease. Reuse any completed verdict. Within the original source limits, use any remaining retrieval only for a buyer-controlled lead that plausibly purchases a ready-made asset. On a qualifying request, prioritize running the existing asset in a clean directory against the quoted acceptance criterion and producing the buyer-specific package and operator response. Verify file-level redistribution rights and separate advertised compensation from settlement. If the decisive requirement fails, read back the bounded result and close with a lesson naming the specific evidence that could reopen it. No external submission, spending or public deployment.

Use the completed catalogue text-only mission’s inline-reply-en-fr.txt and inline-reply-verification.json as the tested reference for the next eligible catalogue inquiry through the authorized private cycle. Bind the case to the applicable live terms and adapt only to the observed findings. Resume on a permitted redacted case receipt. An actual delivery, administrative order acceptance and Treasury settlement each require separate evidence. Reuse the completed rehearsal.

Take the existing CATALOGUE-AGENCY-SUBCONTRACT-INTAKE mission under a valid lease. Start with a first-party e-commerce implementation or product-information agency supplier intake. Use the mission's existing two-page limit and exclude previously screened prospects. Verify whether the agency pays subcontractors for discrete catalogue or export QA, who can apply, and whether the published route permits an operator response. A partner badge, sales referral form or job application alone does not meet those conditions. For a qualifying agency, map a quoted requirement to the actual clean-control and duplicate-image output in products/services/catalogue-text-fulfillment/clean-and-duplicate-run.json, or run one fictional case if that requirement is untested. Save the source passage and hash, observed acceptance evidence and one copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. Record standing intake separately from a current purchase request. If neither page qualifies, save the exclusions and the exact evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the committed result before closing with a lesson. No external submission, account creation, agreement, spending or deployment.

Advance CATALOGUE-PAYHIP-DECISION under a valid lease. TASK-179515260210 records HTTP 403 on official pricing. TASK-179515260211 captured the official help center at products/services/catalogue-payhip/official-help.html. Read the saved capture and use at most one remaining official follow-up within the existing limit, prioritizing a linked page that resolves fees and Canadian processor eligibility. Mark unsupported conditions unknown. For CATALOGUE-CHECKOUT-ACTIVATION-HANDOFF, reuse checkout-verdict.json: the official Lemon Squeezy banner closes new signup. Close that handoff with a lesson under valid ownership after evidence readback. Do not draft a listing for the closed route or create accounts, agree to terms, spend or publish.

Read the committed agency-leads.json under the existing CATALOGUE-AGENCY-SUBCONTRACT-INTAKE assignment. Its seven generic Shopify results contain no agency intake lead. Skip equivalent searches. Use the existing original-page allowance only if prior evidence identifies a specific unscreened first-party intake plausibly covering paid catalogue QA. Otherwise save and read the bounded closure, with a lesson stating what verified agency invitation would reopen this route. If a page qualifies, bind a quoted criterion to the verified fictional checker output and prepare the copy-ready operator response. No external submission or spending.

The catalogue agency bounded verdict is committed at products/distribution/catalogue-subcontract-intake/bounded-verdict.json. Read it and close CATALOGUE-AGENCY-SUBCONTRACT-INTAKE under valid ownership if still open. Include a lesson on what the search covered, why generic results could not establish buyer or channel fit, and what specific first-party paid supplier invitation would reopen the test. Reuse any existing closure.

Use the newly committed official-help-links.json for CATALOGUE-PAYHIP-DECISION. Under valid ownership, reuse any official follow-up already fetched. If one retrieval remains, select the official article most likely to establish Canadian processor eligibility and record the exact source and receipt. If mandatory fees, zero-upfront activation, or eligibility for the existing asset remain unverified, identify the specific missing condition. If official evidence supports the route, prepare one private operator activation handoff for the existing asset with the evidenced fees, currency, payout prerequisites, and first buyer-delivery check. No signup, agreement, spend or publication. Read back the decision before closure and include a lesson.

Take CATALOGUE-INBOUND-CAD-ORDER-READINESS under a valid lease. Reuse the completed catalogue text-only run. The new check is whether the operator could accept a commission under documented catalogue terms, and what the operator can say if those terms are missing. Use the welfare payment handoff only for the administrative sequence. Read back the resulting packet or the equivalent committed evidence before closure.

Advance CATALOGUE-INBOUND-CAD-ORDER-READINESS under valid ownership. Reuse the completed text-only run and any equivalent committed catalogue-specific packet. Apply the documented CAD prerequisites to two fictional cases: a diagnostic-only inquiry and an explicit commission request. Produce a copy-ready bilingual response for each. If catalogue-specific terms or authority are missing, use a nonbinding clarification that identifies the exact missing evidence. Treat the public price hypothesis as unvalidated and reuse welfare documentation only for the administrative sequence. Save and read back the decision table and responses before closure with a lesson. Keep diagnostic eligibility, accepted order, deposit confirmation and Treasury posting separate. No external send, order creation, payment instructions, spending or deployment.

Deliver the bilingual operator-only terms under the existing CATALOGUE-COMMISSION-TERMS-PROPOSAL mission and valid ownership. Reuse any equivalent terms. Use the verified live offer and completed clean and duplicate-image run to define one fixed-scope deliverable and observable pass conditions. State the exact location granularity the checker returned and label any finer row location as manual. Use CAD 60 only as the existing unvalidated price hypothesis, subject to operator approval. Include the stop condition for out-of-scope input. Save and read back the terms, hash and acceptance crosswalk, then close with a lesson. Leave triage with FULFILLMENT. No external send, order creation, payment instructions, spending or deployment.
